name: Restaurant Confirm
view:
<Card
  size="md"
  theme="dark"
  confirm={blocked ? undefined : { label: labels.confirm, action: { type: "order.confirm", payload: { order_id }, handler: "server", loadingBehavior: "container" } }}
  cancel={{ label: labels.edit, action: { type: "order.edit", payload: { order_id }, handler: "server", loadingBehavior: "container" } }}
>
  <Row gap={3}>
    <Box size={44} radius="lg" background="alpha-15" align="center" justify="center">
      <Icon name="check-circle" size="xl" />
    </Box>
    <Col gap={0}>
      <Title value={labels.title} size="sm" />
      <Caption value={order_id} />
    </Col>
  </Row>
  {notice && (
    <Row gap={2} padding={{ x: 3, y: 2 }} radius="lg" background="alpha-10">
      <Icon name="info" size="sm" color="warning" />
      <Text value={notice} size="sm" />
    </Row>
  )}
  <Col gap={2}>
    {lines.map((line) => (
      <Row key={line.id} gap={3}>
        <Box size={36} radius="md" background="alpha-10" align="center" justify="center">
          <Text value={line.emoji} />
        </Box>
        <Col flex={1} gap={0}>
          <Text value={line.name} size="sm" weight="semibold" color={line.available ? "prose" : "tertiary"} />
          <Caption value={line.qty_label} />
        </Col>
        {!line.available && <Badge label={labels.sold_out} color="danger" size="sm" />}
        <Text value={line.line_total} size="sm" weight="semibold" />
      </Row>
    ))}
  </Col>
  <Divider color="subtle" flush />
  <Col gap={1}>
    <Row>
      <Text value={labels.subtotal} size="sm" color="secondary" />
      <Spacer />
      <Text value={subtotal} size="sm" />
    </Row>
    <Row>
      <Text value={labels.delivery} size="sm" color="secondary" />
      <Spacer />
      <Text value={delivery} size="sm" color={delivery_free ? "success" : "prose"} />
    </Row>
    <Row>
      <Text value={labels.total} weight="semibold" />
      <Spacer />
      <Title value={total} size="md" />
    </Row>
  </Col>
</Card>

defaultState.notice: Tabbouleh sold out. You removed it from your order.

value.notice: Tabbouleh sold out. Remove it to place your order.

schema:
import { z } from "zod"

const Line = z.strictObject({
  id: z.string().min(1),
  emoji: z.string(),
  name: z.string().min(1),
  qty_label: z.string(),
  line_total: z.string(),
  available: z.boolean(),
})

const WidgetState = z.strictObject({
  lang: z.enum(["en", "ar"]),
  order_id: z.string().min(1),
  labels: z.strictObject({
    title: z.string(),
    sold_out: z.string(),
    subtotal: z.string(),
    delivery: z.string(),
    total: z.string(),
    confirm: z.string(),
    edit: z.string(),
  }),
  notice: z.string().optional(),
  lines: z.array(Line).min(1),
  subtotal: z.string(),
  delivery: z.string(),
  delivery_free: z.boolean(),
  total: z.string(),
  blocked: z.boolean(),
})

export default WidgetState
